title.en: The Immersive Art Therapy Driven by AIGC: An Innovative Approach to Alleviating Children's Nyctophobia
title.zh: The Immersive Art Therapy Driven by AIGC: An Innovative Approach to Alleviating Children's Nyctophobia

lead.en: An immersive drawing installation explores how children can create reassuring imagery in a darkened space. Its design connects a child-art LoRA, tangible tracking and multi-surface projection.
lead.zh: 这个沉浸式绘画装置探索儿童如何在较暗的空间中创造带来安全感的图像，将儿童绘画风格 LoRA、实体追踪和多表面投影连接起来。

role.en: Research supervision and design review · Corresponding author
role.zh: 研究指导与设计评议 · 通讯作者

authors.en: Jinlin Miao, Zhiyuan Zhou, Yilei Wu, Fenggui Rao*, and Fanjing Meng.
authors.zh: Jinlin Miao, Zhiyuan Zhou, Yilei Wu, Fenggui Rao*, and Fanjing Meng.

en.title: Immersive Art Therapy
en.subtitle: An AIGC-driven approach to children’s nyctophobia
en.summary: Children’s drawings, generated characters and bodily movement meet in an immersive projection space. The work explores how creative expression and responsive imagery can support a gentler encounter with fear-related environments.
en.contribution: Research supervision and design review · Corresponding author

zh.title: 沉浸式艺术疗愈
zh.subtitle: 面向儿童黑暗恐惧的 AIGC 交互探索
zh.summary: 儿童绘画、生成角色与身体运动在沉浸投影空间中汇合。项目探索如何通过创作表达与响应式图像，支持对恐惧相关环境的渐进接触。
zh.contribution: 研究指导与设计评议 · 通讯作者

title.en: CityCure: Walk, Capture, and Reimagine Street Micro-Interventions with In-Situ MR and GenAI
title.zh: CityCure: Walk, Capture, and Reimagine Street Micro-Interventions with In-Situ MR and GenAI

lead.en: CityCure makes a street-design proposal part of an ordinary walk. Gesture capture, spoken intentions and mixed-reality alternatives connect a noticed problem to a proposal that others can discuss.
lead.zh: CityCure 让街道设计提案成为日常步行的一部分。手势捕捉、语音意图与混合现实方案，将现场发现的问题连接到可共同讨论的提案。

authors.en: Yuhao He, Fenggui Rao, and Tian Tian Lo.
authors.zh: Yuhao He, Fenggui Rao, and Tian Tian Lo.

title.en: ContextCam: Bridging Context Awareness with Creative Human-AI Image Co-Creation
title.zh: ContextCam: Bridging Context Awareness with Creative Human-AI Image Co-Creation

lead.en: ContextCam starts image creation from the situation a person is already in. A context-aware, five-agent workflow turns surroundings and intentions into topic choices, generated images and conversational revisions.
lead.zh: ContextCam 从用户当下所处的情境开启图像创作。它通过感知情境的五智能体工作流，将环境与意图转化为主题选择、图像生成和对话式修改。

role.en: UI/UX design · Android development · Paper figures & architecture diagram
role.zh: UI/UX 设计 · Android 前端开发 · 论文图表与架构图

authors.en: Xianzhe Fan, Zihan Wu, Chun Yu, Fenggui Rao, Weinan Shi*, and Teng Tu.
authors.zh: Xianzhe Fan, Zihan Wu, Chun Yu, Fenggui Rao, Weinan Shi*, and Teng Tu.

en.title: ContextCam
en.subtitle: Bridging Context Awareness with Creative Human–AI Image Co-Creation
en.summary: A mobile co-creation system turns the situation around a person into ideas for images. Five agents coordinate context selection, topic suggestions, conversation, editing tools and personal preferences.
en.contribution: UI/UX design · Android development · Paper figures & architecture diagram

zh.title: ContextCam
zh.subtitle: 让情境感知参与人机图像共创
zh.summary: 一个从用户当下情境中寻找图像灵感的移动共创系统。五个智能体分别协调情境筛选、主题建议、对话、编辑工具与个人偏好。
zh.contribution: UI/UX 设计 · Android 前端开发 · 论文图表与架构图

title.en: DisFace3DNet: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement
title.zh: DisFace3DNet: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement

lead.en: DisFace3DNet turns an overall facial-attractiveness prediction into seven component scores with explicit numerical contributions. The research connects controllable 3D representations with a prediction that can be inspected part by part.
lead.zh: DisFace3DNet 将整体面部吸引力预测拆解为七项成分评分及其明确的数值贡献，把可控三维表征与可逐项检查的预测结果连接起来。

role.zh: 分量模型设计与实验评估

authors.en: Fenggui Rao, Yan Luximon*, and Jie Zhang*.
authors.zh: Fenggui Rao, Yan Luximon*, and Jie Zhang*.

en.title: DisFace3DNet
en.subtitle: Explainable Facial Attractiveness Prediction via 3D Component Disentanglement
en.summary: Seven component routes connect a face photograph to an overall prediction. Their weighted contributions add up to the model’s score, making its use of visual evidence inspectable.

zh.title: DisFace3DNet
zh.subtitle: 通过三维成分解耦，实现可解释的面部吸引力预测
zh.summary: 七条成分分支将人脸照片连接到整体预测。各项加权贡献能够相加还原模型评分，使模型如何使用视觉证据可以逐项检查。
zh.contribution: 分量模型设计与实验评估

title.en: Between Real and Imagined: Developing a dynamic immersive virtual auditing framework for high-density urban health trails
title.zh: Between Real and Imagined: Developing a dynamic immersive virtual auditing framework for high-density urban health trails

lead.en: DIVA structures the evaluation of urban health trails as an end-to-end experimental workflow: reconstruct a place, vary its design, observe an immersive walk and translate multimodal measurements into design feedback.
lead.zh: DIVA 将城市健康步道的评估组织为完整实验流程：重建场所、改变设计、观察沉浸式步行，再将多模态测量转化为设计反馈。

authors.en: Yuhao He, Tian Tian Lo, Fenggui Rao, Yuhao Li, and Hanzhe Bao.
authors.zh: Yuhao He, Tian Tian Lo, Fenggui Rao, Yuhao Li, and Hanzhe Bao.

title.en: Facial Social Trait Perception, Interpretation, and Prediction: A State-of-the-Art Review
title.zh: Facial Social Trait Perception, Interpretation, and Prediction: A State-of-the-Art Review

lead.en: A review organized around the full path from facial variables to human judgments, interpretation and computational prediction. It brings psychology, measurement and machine learning into one research framework.
lead.zh: 这篇综述沿着面部变量、人类判断、解释与计算预测的完整路径展开，将心理学、测量与机器学习放进同一研究框架。

role.zh: 综述结构与研究方法梳理

title.en: Flowing Ink Resonator: An Embodied Soundscape for Culturally Grounded Authoring under Rare Records
title.zh: Flowing Ink Resonator: An Embodied Soundscape for Culturally Grounded Authoring under Rare Records

lead.en: Flowing Ink Resonator turns literary traces of the Grand Canal into a playable audiovisual environment. Rhythmic bodily action selects and shapes reusable sound events while an ink-wash projection responds in real time.
lead.zh: Flowing Ink Resonator 将大运河的文学线索转化为可演奏的视听环境。身体节律选择并塑造可复用的声音事件，水墨投影随之实时响应。

lead.en: A swarm tangible interface connects physical robots, tracking and projected visuals for live performance. The prototype extends Rovable-style fabric climbing into a spatial installation that performers and audiences can manipulate.
lead.zh: 这个群体实体界面将物理机器人、追踪与投影视觉连接到现场表演中，把 Rovable 式布面攀爬扩展为可供表演者和观众操控的空间装置。

title.en: Streets as Shared Canvases: An In-Situ Mixed Reality Platform for Citizen-Led Urban Restorative Design
title.zh: Streets as Shared Canvases: An In-Situ Mixed Reality Platform for Citizen-Led Urban Restorative Design

lead.en: An in-situ mixed-reality platform brings street assessment and design into the same walk. People capture their surroundings, describe their experience and develop scene-conditioned alternatives with AI and other participants.
lead.zh: 这个原位混合现实平台把街道评估与设计放进同一次步行：人们记录周围环境、描述体验，并与 AI 和其他参与者共同发展基于现场的改造方案。

authors.en: Yuhao He, Tian Tian Lo, and Fenggui Rao.
authors.zh: Yuhao He, Tian Tian Lo, and Fenggui Rao.

title.en: Crowdsourcing StreetCure: A Workshop-Derived Human-AI Pipeline for Restorative Street Micro-Interventions
title.zh: Crowdsourcing StreetCure: A Workshop-Derived Human-AI Pipeline for Restorative Street Micro-Interventions

lead.en: StreetCure connects residents’ street experiences to measurable variables and generative redesign. Its three-stage workflow grew out of a Guangzhou workshop and was formalized into a mobile-first prototype.
lead.zh: StreetCure 将居民的街道体验连接到可测量变量与生成式改造。其三阶段工作流源于广州工作坊，并进一步整理为移动端优先的原型。

authors.zh: Yuhao He, Tiantian Lo, Yongming Chen, and Fenggui Rao.

title.en: TrailTracking: AI-Driven Distributed Narratives of Descendant Civilizations in a Digitally Encoded Cosmos

lead.en: TrailTracking builds a science-fiction game narrative around a civilization discovering its artificial universe. Exploration, archaeology and puzzles turn the setting’s hidden history into something the player can uncover.
lead.zh: 《索迹》围绕一个文明发现自身所处人造宇宙的过程构建科幻游戏叙事，通过探索、考古和解谜，让玩家逐步揭开世界的隐秘历史。
